_template_note: Fill this file before claiming a CST electromagnetic model is ready. The validator intentionally fails while any gate is blocked or not_executed.

requirements.pass_condition: task type, project source, output expectation, save policy, automation mode, frequency band, and simulation permission are recorded

physical_structure.pass_condition: topology, coordinate system, propagation or radiation direction, layers, conductors, feed, and boundary meaning are recorded

parameterization.pass_condition: units and reusable CST parameters exist before History commands reference them

materials.pass_condition: dielectrics, conductors, losses, and background materials match the structure brief

geometry_connectivity.pass_condition: objects, dimensions, contacts, clearances, and ground or shield continuity match the structure brief

port.pass_condition: feed type, CST port object, physical section or terminals, reference conductor, dielectric, orientation, and calibration are consistent

boundary_background.pass_condition: background and boundaries match antenna, waveguide, periodic, symmetry, or cavity physics

solver_mesh_monitors.pass_condition: solver type, frequency range, S-parameter normalization, monitors, mesh strategy, and refinements match requested metrics
solver_mesh_monitors.unchecked_risk: for no-simulation workflows, include: no solver run; no port-mode solve; no S-parameter/farfield/gain/efficiency conclusion

history.pass_condition: visible persisted History captions exist for parameters, materials, geometry, ports, boundaries, mesh, monitors, and solver setup

save_and_simulation_state.pass_condition: save path, project version, close policy, and result-tree/simulation state are recorded
save_and_simulation_state.unchecked_risk: for no-simulation workflows, include: no solver run; no port-mode solve; no S-parameter results

delivery.pass_condition: project path, design id, gate ledger, port record, History evidence, assumptions, risks, and next action are reported
